purpose: Training-only feasibility of evidence-preserving probability calibration
partition: Keep original head-fit sequences/checkpoints. Stratify remaining original training sequences by any background support; SHA256-rank once per stratum, use even ranks for calibration and odd ranks for evaluation. Do not retry splits.
mapping: e'_k=exp(theta_k)*e_k; alpha'=e'+1; preserve b=e'/sum(alpha'), u=2/sum(alpha'), p=alpha'/sum(alpha')
optimizer: CPU float64 L-BFGS strong Wolfe, theta=bound*tanh(raw/bound), identity initialization
objective: Calibration-sequence natural-prevalence-weighted negative log likelihood plus regularization*mean(theta^2); no evaluation outcomes enter fitting
runs: Every saved natural-prevalence and class-balanced head at seeds 11,22,33; report raw and calibrated results, no best seed/objective/mapping selection
gate: Evaluation UAV and background recalls both >0.5; calibrated Brier and log loss strictly improve over raw, and Brier beats constant calibration-population-prevalence reference. Report each seed; all seeds must pass for an objective to pass the diagnostic.
limits: All subsets come from original training data already involved in development; conditional head-level diagnostic, not an unbiased final test. No official validation features, images, corruption or conflict scoring. Valid opinion identities do not establish calibrated evidential uncertainty. No automatic primary approval.
